scope: Exactly one co request and whole bounded capture; no commissioning coordinator or CLI command
invariants: One fresh numeric-IP socket and at most one sendall call
No retry, inventory, SMART reset, option write, STORE or MATCHDB request
Full fixed response window; pure receipt parsing after close
Capture completeness and retained packet correlation reported independently
Original interruption carries partial evidence with no follow-up request
limitations: No source or target inventory guards
Endpoint exclusivity and physical mutation preconditions are caller responsibilities
Non-atomic inventory and real-device persistence remain outside transport scope
Fixture tests use explicit shorter synthetic response/serial windows; default2s independently tested with literal peer
